name: diabetes-full-lr
title: Diabetes-related risk score
description: Logistic regression on glucose, BMI, age and diastolic blood pressure (PIMA-trained).

dataset.name: PIMA Indians Diabetes Database
dataset.source: Originally from the National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (NIDDK); distributed via widely mirrored public copies (jbrownlee/Datasets, plotly/datasets).
dataset.license: Public research dataset, commonly distributed as CC0 / public domain via mirrors.

notes: Trained on the PIMA dataset. IMPORTANT: the dataset glucose field is a 2-hour oral glucose tolerance test value, while the application typically provides fasting glucose — treat outputs as rough educational estimates, not clinical probabilities. Dataset population: Pima women aged 21+ (not representative). See docs/ML.md for full limitations.
